sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pavel Yegorovich Romanenko, known by his alias "Prapor", is a trader in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: The Warrant officer in charge of supply warehouses on the sustaining base enforcing the Norvinsk region blockade. Secretly supplied the BEAR PMC operators with weapons, ammunition, and various other provisions he had at his disposal during the Contract Wars.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Prapor is initially locked, and can be unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.
